# Teacher Bek

> Teacher Bek is an English teacher based in Phú Nhuận, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. He teaches small-group English (maximum 10 students per group) for young learners aged 5–10 and teens aged 11–17 (students aged 5 to 17 only). Lessons are available in person and online.

Website: https://teacherbek.com

## Programs

- Young Learners (ages 5–10): small-group English with speaking from the first session
- Teens (ages 11–17): small-group English

Group size: maximum 10 students per class. Classes are offered in person and online.

Free trial: free first week. Pricing on request via the site form.
